155// Internal Assertions and errors
156#if !defined(ELPP_DISABLE_ASSERT)
157# if (defined(ELPP_DEBUG_ASSERT_FAILURE))
158# define ELPP_ASSERT(expr, msg) if (!(expr)) { \
159std::stringstream internalInfoStream; internalInfoStream << msg; \
160ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_OUT_ERROR \
161<< "EASYLOGGING++ ASSERTION FAILED (LINE: " << __LINE__ << ") [" #expr << "] WITH MESSAGE \"" \
162<< ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_MSG(internalInfoStream.str()) << "\"" << ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_ENDL; base::utils::abort(1, \
163"ELPP Assertion failure, please define ELPP_DEBUG_ASSERT_FAILURE"); }
164# else
165# define ELPP_ASSERT(expr, msg) if (!(expr)) { \
166std::stringstream internalInfoStream; internalInfoStream << msg; \
167ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_OUT_ERROR\
168<< "ASSERTION FAILURE FROM EASYLOGGING++ (LINE: " \
169<< __LINE__ << ") [" #expr << "] WITH MESSAGE \"" << ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_MSG(internalInfoStream.str()) << "\"" \
170<< ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_ENDL; }
171# endif // (defined(ELPP_DEBUG_ASSERT_FAILURE))
172#else
173# define ELPP_ASSERT(x, y)
174#endif //(!defined(ELPP_DISABLE_ASSERT)
175#if ELPP_COMPILER_MSVC
176# define ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_WRITE_PERROR \
177{ char buff[256]; strerror_s(buff, 256, errno); \
178ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_OUT_ERROR << ": " << buff << " [" << errno << "]";} (void)0
179#else
180# define ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_WRITE_PERROR \
181ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_OUT_ERROR << ": " << strerror(errno) << " [" << errno << "]"; (void)0
182#endif // ELPP_COMPILER_MSVC
183#if defined(ELPP_DEBUG_ERRORS)
184# if !defined(ELPP_INTERNAL_ERROR)
185# define ELPP_INTERNAL_ERROR(msg, pe) { \
186std::stringstream internalInfoStream; internalInfoStream << "<ERROR> " << msg; \
187ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_OUT_ERROR \
188<< "ERROR FROM EASYLOGGING++ (LINE: " << __LINE__ << ") " \
189<< ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_MSG(internalInfoStream.str()) << ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_ENDL; \
190if (pe) { ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_OUT_ERROR << " "; ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_WRITE_PERROR; }} (void)0
191# endif
192#else
193# undef ELPP_INTERNAL_INFO
194# define ELPP_INTERNAL_ERROR(msg, pe)
195#endif // defined(ELPP_DEBUG_ERRORS)
196#if (defined(ELPP_DEBUG_INFO))
197# if !(defined(ELPP_INTERNAL_INFO_LEVEL))
198# define ELPP_INTERNAL_INFO_LEVEL 9
199# endif // !(defined(ELPP_INTERNAL_INFO_LEVEL))
200# if !defined(ELPP_INTERNAL_INFO)
201# define ELPP_INTERNAL_INFO(lvl, msg) { if (lvl <= ELPP_INTERNAL_INFO_LEVEL) { \
202std::stringstream internalInfoStream; internalInfoStream << "<INFO> " << msg; \
203ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_OUT_INFO << ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_MSG(internalInfoStream.str()) \
204<< ELPP_INTERNAL_DEBUGGING_ENDL; }}
205# endif
206#else
207# undef ELPP_INTERNAL_INFO
208# define ELPP_INTERNAL_INFO(lvl, msg)
209#endif // (defined(ELPP_DEBUG_INFO))

575enum class Level : base::type::EnumType {
577 Global = 1,
579 Trace = 2,
581 Debug = 4,
583 Fatal = 8,
585 Error = 16,
587 Warning = 32,
589 Verbose = 64,
591 Info = 128,
593 Unknown = 1010
594};
595} // namespace el
596namespace std {
597template<> struct hash<el::Level> {
598 public:
599 std::size_t operator()(const el::Level& l) const {
600 return hash<el::base::type::EnumType> {}(static_cast<el::base::type::EnumType>(l));
601 }
602};
603}
604namespace el {
606class LevelHelper : base::StaticClass {
607 public:
609 static const base::type::EnumType kMinValid = static_cast<base::type::EnumType>(Level::Trace);
611 static const base::type::EnumType kMaxValid = static_cast<base::type::EnumType>(Level::Info);
613 static base::type::EnumType castToInt(Level level) {
614 return static_cast<base::type::EnumType>(level);

880 return static_cast<base::type::EnumType>(flag) & static_cast<base::type::EnumType>(e);
881}
882template <typename Enum>
883static inline base::type::EnumType Not(Enum e, base::type::EnumType flag) {
884 return static_cast<base::type::EnumType>(flag) & ~(static_cast<base::type::EnumType>(e));
885}
886template <typename Enum>
887static inline base::type::EnumType Or(Enum e, base::type::EnumType flag) {
888 return static_cast<base::type::EnumType>(flag) | static_cast<base::type::EnumType>(e);

893 *flag = base::utils::bitwise::Or<Enum>(e, *flag);

896static inline void removeFlag(Enum e, base::type::EnumType* flag) {
897 *flag = base::utils::bitwise::Not<Enum>(e, *flag);
898}

900static inline bool hasFlag(Enum e, base::type::EnumType flag) {
901 return base::utils::bitwise::And<Enum>(e, flag) > 0x0;

904namespace threading {
905#if ELPP_THREADING_ENABLED
906# if !ELPP_USE_STD_THREADING
907namespace internal {
909class Mutex : base::NoCopy {
910 public:
911 Mutex(void) {
912# if ELPP_OS_UNIX
913 pthread_mutexattr_t attr;
914 pthread_mutexattr_init(&attr);
915 pthread_mutexattr_settype(&attr, PTHREAD_MUTEX_RECURSIVE);
916 pthread_mutex_init(&m_underlyingMutex, &attr);
917 pthread_mutexattr_destroy(&attr);
918# elif ELPP_OS_WINDOWS
919 InitializeCriticalSection(&m_underlyingMutex);
920# endif // ELPP_OS_UNIX
921 }
922
923 virtual ~Mutex(void) {
924# if ELPP_OS_UNIX
925 pthread_mutex_destroy(&m_underlyingMutex);
926# elif ELPP_OS_WINDOWS
927 DeleteCriticalSection(&m_underlyingMutex);
928# endif // ELPP_OS_UNIX
929 }
930
931 inline void lock(void) {
932# if ELPP_OS_UNIX
933 pthread_mutex_lock(&m_underlyingMutex);
934# elif ELPP_OS_WINDOWS
935 EnterCriticalSection(&m_underlyingMutex);
936# endif // ELPP_OS_UNIX
937 }
938
939 inline bool try_lock(void) {
940# if ELPP_OS_UNIX
941 return (pthread_mutex_trylock(&m_underlyingMutex) == 0);
942# elif ELPP_OS_WINDOWS
943 return TryEnterCriticalSection(&m_underlyingMutex);
944# endif // ELPP_OS_UNIX
945 }
946
947 inline void unlock(void) {
948# if ELPP_OS_UNIX
949 pthread_mutex_unlock(&m_underlyingMutex);
950# elif ELPP_OS_WINDOWS
951 LeaveCriticalSection(&m_underlyingMutex);
952# endif // ELPP_OS_UNIX
953 }
954
955 private:
956# if ELPP_OS_UNIX
957 pthread_mutex_t m_underlyingMutex;
958# elif ELPP_OS_WINDOWS
959 CRITICAL_SECTION m_underlyingMutex;
960# endif // ELPP_OS_UNIX
961};
963template <typename M>
964class ScopedLock : base::NoCopy {
965 public:
966 explicit ScopedLock(M& mutex) {
967 m_mutex = &mutex;
968 m_mutex->lock();
969 }
970
971 virtual ~ScopedLock(void) {
972 m_mutex->unlock();
973 }
974 private:
975 M* m_mutex;
976 ScopedLock(void);
977};
978} // namespace internal

980typedef base::threading::internal::ScopedLock<base::threading::Mutex> ScopedLock;
981# else

984# endif // !ELPP_USE_STD_THREADING
985#else

988class NoMutex : base::NoCopy {

1016 virtual inline void releaseLock(void) ELPP_FINAL { m_mutex.unlock(); }
1017 virtual inline base::threading::Mutex& lock(void) ELPP_FINAL { return m_mutex; }
1018 protected:

1021 private:

1265template <typename T_Ptr, typename Container>
1266class AbstractRegistry : public base::threading::ThreadSafe {
1267 public:
1268 typedef typename Container::iterator iterator;
1269 typedef typename Container::const_iterator const_iterator;
1270
1272 AbstractRegistry(void) {}
1273
1275 AbstractRegistry(AbstractRegistry&& sr) {
1276 if (this == &sr) {
1277 return;
1278 }
1279 unregisterAll();
1280 m_list = std::move(sr.m_list);
1281 }
1282
1283 bool operator==(const AbstractRegistry<T_Ptr, Container>& other) {
1284 if (size() != other.size()) {
1285 return false;
1286 }
1287 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_list.size(); ++i) {
1288 if (m_list.at(i) != other.m_list.at(i)) {
1289 return false;
1290 }
1291 }
1292 return true;
1293 }
1294
1295 bool operator!=(const AbstractRegistry<T_Ptr, Container>& other) {
1296 if (size() != other.size()) {
1297 return true;
1298 }
1299 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_list.size(); ++i) {
1300 if (m_list.at(i) != other.m_list.at(i)) {
1301 return true;
1302 }
1303 }
1304 return false;
1305 }
1306
1308 AbstractRegistry& operator=(AbstractRegistry&& sr) {
1309 if (this == &sr) {
1310 return *this;
1311 }
1312 unregisterAll();
1313 m_list = std::move(sr.m_list);
1314 return *this;
1315 }
1316
1317 virtual ~AbstractRegistry(void) {
1318 }
1319
1321 virtual inline iterator begin(void) ELPP_FINAL {
1322 return m_list.begin();
1323 }
1324
1326 virtual inline iterator end(void) ELPP_FINAL {
1327 return m_list.end();
1328 }
1329
1330
1332 virtual inline const_iterator cbegin(void) const ELPP_FINAL {
1333 return m_list.cbegin();
1334 }
1335
1337 virtual inline const_iterator cend(void) const ELPP_FINAL {
1338 return m_list.cend();
1339 }
1340
1342 virtual inline bool empty(void) const ELPP_FINAL {
1343 return m_list.empty();
1344 }
1345
1347 virtual inline std::size_t size(void) const ELPP_FINAL {
1348 return m_list.size();
1349 }
1350
1352 virtual inline Container& list(void) ELPP_FINAL {
1353 return m_list;
1354 }
1355
1357 virtual inline const Container& list(void) const ELPP_FINAL {
1358 return m_list;
1359 }
1360
1362 virtual void unregisterAll(void) = 0;
1363
1364 protected:
1365 virtual void deepCopy(const AbstractRegistry<T_Ptr, Container>&) = 0;
1366 void reinitDeepCopy(const AbstractRegistry<T_Ptr, Container>& sr) {
1367 unregisterAll();
1368 deepCopy(sr);
1369 }
1370
1371 private:
1372 Container m_list;
1373};

1380template <typename T_Ptr, typename T_Key = const char*>
1381class Registry : public AbstractRegistry<T_Ptr, std::unordered_map<T_Key, T_Ptr*>> {
1382 public:
1383 typedef typename Registry<T_Ptr, T_Key>::iterator iterator;
1384 typedef typename Registry<T_Ptr, T_Key>::const_iterator const_iterator;
1385
1386 Registry(void) {}
1387
1389 Registry(const Registry& sr) : AbstractRegistry<T_Ptr, std::vector<T_Ptr*>>() {
1390 if (this == &sr) {
1391 return;
1392 }
1393 this->reinitDeepCopy(sr);
1394 }
1395
1399 Registry& operator=(const Registry& sr) {
1400 if (this == &sr) {
1401 return *this;
1402 }
1403 this->reinitDeepCopy(sr);
1404 return *this;
1405 }
1406
1407 virtual ~Registry(void) {
1408 unregisterAll();
1409 }
1410
1411 protected:
1412 virtual void unregisterAll(void) ELPP_FINAL {
1413 if (!this->empty()) {
1414 for (auto&& curr : this->list()) {
1415 base::utils::safeDelete(curr.second);
1416 }
1417 this->list().clear();
1418 }
1419 }
1420
1422 virtual void registerNew(const T_Key& uniqKey, T_Ptr* ptr) ELPP_FINAL {
1423 unregister(uniqKey);
1424 this->list().insert(std::make_pair(uniqKey, ptr));
1425 }
1426
1428 void unregister(const T_Key& uniqKey) {
1429 T_Ptr* existing = get(uniqKey);
1430 if (existing != nullptr) {
1431 this->list().erase(uniqKey);
1432 base::utils::safeDelete(existing);
1433 }
1434 }
1435
1437 T_Ptr* get(const T_Key& uniqKey) {
1438 iterator it = this->list().find(uniqKey);
1439 return it == this->list().end()
1440 ? nullptr
1441 : it->second;
1442 }
1443
1444 private:
1445 virtual void deepCopy(const AbstractRegistry<T_Ptr, std::unordered_map<T_Key, T_Ptr*>>& sr) ELPP_FINAL {
1446 for (const_iterator it = sr.cbegin(); it != sr.cend(); ++it) {
1447 registerNew(it->first, new T_Ptr(*it->second));
1448 }
1449 }
1450};

1456template <typename T_Ptr, typename Pred>
1457class RegistryWithPred : public AbstractRegistry<T_Ptr, std::vector<T_Ptr*>> {
1458 public:
1459 typedef typename RegistryWithPred<T_Ptr, Pred>::iterator iterator;
1460 typedef typename RegistryWithPred<T_Ptr, Pred>::const_iterator const_iterator;
1461
1462 RegistryWithPred(void) {
1463 }
1464
1465 virtual ~RegistryWithPred(void) {
1466 unregisterAll();
1467 }
1468
1470 RegistryWithPred(const RegistryWithPred& sr) : AbstractRegistry<T_Ptr, std::vector<T_Ptr*>>() {
1471 if (this == &sr) {
1472 return;
1473 }
1474 this->reinitDeepCopy(sr);
1475 }
1476
1480 RegistryWithPred& operator=(const RegistryWithPred& sr) {
1481 if (this == &sr) {
1482 return *this;
1483 }
1484 this->reinitDeepCopy(sr);
1485 return *this;
1486 }
1487
1488 friend base::type::ostream_t& operator<<(base::type::ostream_t& os, const RegistryWithPred& sr) {
1489 for (const_iterator it = sr.list().begin(); it != sr.list().end(); ++it) {
1490 os << ELPP_LITERAL(" ") << **it << ELPP_LITERAL("\n");
1491 }
1492 return os;
1493 }
1494
1495 protected:
1496 virtual void unregisterAll(void) ELPP_FINAL {
1497 if (!this->empty()) {
1498 for (auto&& curr : this->list()) {
1499 base::utils::safeDelete(curr);
1500 }
1501 this->list().clear();
1502 }
1503 }
1504
1505 virtual void unregister(T_Ptr*& ptr) ELPP_FINAL {
1506 if (ptr) {
1507 iterator iter = this->begin();
1508 for (; iter != this->end(); ++iter) {
1509 if (ptr == *iter) {
1510 break;
1511 }
1512 }
1513 if (iter != this->end() && *iter != nullptr) {
1514 this->list().erase(iter);
1515 base::utils::safeDelete(*iter);
1516 }
1517 }
1518 }
1519
1520 virtual inline void registerNew(T_Ptr* ptr) ELPP_FINAL {
1521 this->list().push_back(ptr);
1522 }
1523
1526 template <typename T, typename T2>
1527 T_Ptr* get(const T& arg1, const T2 arg2) {
1528 iterator iter = std::find_if(this->list().begin(), this->list().end(), Pred(arg1, arg2));
1529 if (iter != this->list().end() && *iter != nullptr) {
1530 return *iter;
1531 }
1532 return nullptr;
1533 }
1534
1535 private:
1536 virtual void deepCopy(const AbstractRegistry<T_Ptr, std::vector<T_Ptr*>>& sr) {
1537 for (const_iterator it = sr.list().begin(); it != sr.list().end(); ++it) {
1538 registerNew(new T_Ptr(**it));
1539 }
1540 }
1541};
1542class Utils {
1543 public:
1544 template <typename T, typename TPtr>
1545 static bool installCallback(const std::string& id, std::unordered_map<std::string, TPtr>* mapT) {
1546 if (mapT->find(id) == mapT->end()) {
1547 mapT->insert(std::make_pair(id, TPtr(new T())));
1548 return true;
1549 }
1550 return false;
1551 }
1552
1553 template <typename T, typename TPtr>
1554 static void uninstallCallback(const std::string& id, std::unordered_map<std::string, TPtr>* mapT) {
1555 if (mapT->find(id) != mapT->end()) {
1556 mapT->erase(id);
1557 }
1558 }
1559
1560 template <typename T, typename TPtr>
1561 static T* callback(const std::string& id, std::unordered_map<std::string, TPtr>* mapT) {
1562 typename std::unordered_map<std::string, TPtr>::iterator iter = mapT->find(id);
1563 if (iter != mapT->end()) {
1564 return static_cast<T*>(iter->second.get());
1565 }
1566 return nullptr;
1567 }
1568};

1968 template <typename Conf_T>
1969 inline Conf_T getConfigByVal(Level level, const std::unordered_map<Level, Conf_T>* confMap, const char* confName) {
1970 base::threading::ScopedLock scopedLock(lock());
1971 return unsafeGetConfigByVal(level, confMap, confName); // This is not unsafe anymore - mutex locked in scope
1972 }
1973
1974 template <typename Conf_T>
1975 inline Conf_T& getConfigByRef(Level level, std::unordered_map<Level, Conf_T>* confMap, const char* confName) {
1976 base::threading::ScopedLock scopedLock(lock());
1977 return unsafeGetConfigByRef(level, confMap, confName); // This is not unsafe anymore - mutex locked in scope
1978 }
1979
1980 template <typename Conf_T>
1981 Conf_T unsafeGetConfigByVal(Level level, const std::unordered_map<Level, Conf_T>* confMap, const char* confName) {
1982 ELPP_UNUSED(confName);
1983 typename std::unordered_map<Level, Conf_T>::const_iterator it = confMap->find(level);
1984 if (it == confMap->end()) {
1985 typename std::unordered_map<Level, Conf_T>::const_iterator default_value = confMap->find(Level::Global);
1986 if (default_value == confMap->end()) {
1987 ELPP_INTERNAL_ERROR("Unable to get configuration [" << confName << "] for level ["
1988 << LevelHelper::convertToString(level) << "]"
1989 << std::endl << "Please ensure you have properly configured logger.", false);
1990 return Conf_T();
1991 } else {
1992 return default_value->second;
1993 }
1994 }
1995 return it->second;
1996 }
1997
1998 template <typename Conf_T>
1999 Conf_T& unsafeGetConfigByRef(Level level, std::unordered_map<Level, Conf_T>* confMap, const char* confName) {
2000 ELPP_UNUSED(confName);
2001 typename std::unordered_map<Level, Conf_T>::iterator it = confMap->find(level);
2002 if (it == confMap->end()) {
2003 typename std::unordered_map<Level, Conf_T>::iterator default_value = confMap->find(Level::Global);
2004 if (default_value == confMap->end()) {
2005 ELPP_INTERNAL_ERROR("Unable to get configuration [" << confName << "] for level ["
2006 << LevelHelper::convertToString(level) << "]"
2007 << std::endl << "Please ensure you have properly configured logger.", false);
2008 } else {
2009 return default_value->second;
2010 }
2011 }
2012 return it->second;
2013 }
2014
2015 template <typename Conf_T>
2016 void setValue(Level level, const Conf_T& value, std::unordered_map<Level, Conf_T>* confMap,
2017 bool includeGlobalLevel = true) {
2018 // If map is empty and we are allowed to add into generic level (Level::Global), do it!
2019 if (confMap->empty() && includeGlobalLevel) {
2020 confMap->insert(std::make_pair(Level::Global, value));
2021 return;
2022 }
2023 // If same value exist in generic level already, dont add it to explicit level
2024 typename std::unordered_map<Level, Conf_T>::iterator it = confMap->find(Level::Global);
2025 if (it != confMap->end() && it->second == value) {
2026 return;
2027 }
2028 // Now make sure we dont double up values if we really need to add it to explicit level
2029 it = confMap->find(level);
2030 if (it == confMap->end()) {
2031 // Value not found for level, add new
2032 confMap->insert(std::make_pair(level, value));
2033 } else {
2034 // Value found, just update value
2035 confMap->at(level) = value;
2036 }
2037 }

2832template <typename T, typename Container>
2833class IterableContainer {
2834 public:
2835 typedef typename Container::iterator iterator;
2836 typedef typename Container::const_iterator const_iterator;
2837 IterableContainer(void) {}
2838 virtual ~IterableContainer(void) {}
2839 iterator begin(void) {
2840 return getContainer().begin();
2841 }
2842 iterator end(void) {
2843 return getContainer().end();
2844 }
2845 private:
2846 virtual Container& getContainer(void) = 0;
2847};
2849template<typename T, typename Container = std::vector<T>, typename Comparator = std::less<typename Container::value_type>>
2850class IterablePriorityQueue : public IterableContainer<T, Container>,
2851 public std::priority_queue<T, Container, Comparator> {
2852 public:
2853 IterablePriorityQueue(std::priority_queue<T, Container, Comparator> queue_) {
2854 std::size_t count_ = 0;
2855 while (++count_ < base::consts::kMaxLogPerContainer && !queue_.empty()) {
2856 this->push(queue_.top());
2857 queue_.pop();
2858 }
2859 }
2860 private:
2861 inline Container& getContainer(void) {
2862 return this->c;
2863 }
2864};
2866template<typename T, typename Container = std::deque<T>>
2867class IterableQueue : public IterableContainer<T, Container>, public std::queue<T, Container> {
2868 public:
2869 IterableQueue(std::queue<T, Container> queue_) {
2870 std::size_t count_ = 0;
2871 while (++count_ < base::consts::kMaxLogPerContainer && !queue_.empty()) {
2872 this->push(queue_.front());
2873 queue_.pop();
2874 }
2875 }
2876 private:
2877 inline Container& getContainer(void) {
2878 return this->c;
2879 }
2880};
2882template<typename T, typename Container = std::deque<T>>
2883class IterableStack : public IterableContainer<T, Container>, public std::stack<T, Container> {
2884 public:
2885 IterableStack(std::stack<T, Container> stack_) {
2886 std::size_t count_ = 0;
2887 while (++count_ < base::consts::kMaxLogPerContainer && !stack_.empty()) {
2888 this->push(stack_.top());
2889 stack_.pop();
2890 }
2891 }
2892 private:
2893 inline Container& getContainer(void) {
2894 return this->c;
2895 }
2896};

2946#define ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_ONE_ARG(temp) \
2947template <typename T> \
2948inline MessageBuilder& operator<<(const temp<T>& template_inst) { \
2949return writeIterator(template_inst.begin(), template_inst.end(), template_inst.size()); \
2950}
2951#define ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_TWO_ARG(temp) \
2952template <typename T1, typename T2> \
2953inline MessageBuilder& operator<<(const temp<T1, T2>& template_inst) { \
2954return writeIterator(template_inst.begin(), template_inst.end(), template_inst.size()); \
2955}
2956#define ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_THREE_ARG(temp) \
2957template <typename T1, typename T2, typename T3> \
2958inline MessageBuilder& operator<<(const temp<T1, T2, T3>& template_inst) { \
2959return writeIterator(template_inst.begin(), template_inst.end(), template_inst.size()); \
2960}
2961#define ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_FOUR_ARG(temp) \
2962template <typename T1, typename T2, typename T3, typename T4> \
2963inline MessageBuilder& operator<<(const temp<T1, T2, T3, T4>& template_inst) { \
2964return writeIterator(template_inst.begin(), template_inst.end(), template_inst.size()); \
2965}
2966#define ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_FIVE_ARG(temp) \
2967template <typename T1, typename T2, typename T3, typename T4, typename T5> \
2968inline MessageBuilder& operator<<(const temp<T1, T2, T3, T4, T5>& template_inst) { \
2969return writeIterator(template_inst.begin(), template_inst.end(), template_inst.size()); \
2970}
2971
2972#if defined(ELPP_STL_LOGGING)
2973 ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_TWO_ARG(std::vector)
2974 ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_TWO_ARG(std::list)
2975 ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_TWO_ARG(std::deque)
2976 ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_THREE_ARG(std::set)
2977 ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_THREE_ARG(std::multiset)
2978 ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_FOUR_ARG(std::map)
2979 ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_FOUR_ARG(std::multimap)
2980 template <class T, class Container>
2981 inline MessageBuilder& operator<<(const std::queue<T, Container>& queue_) {
2982 base::workarounds::IterableQueue<T, Container> iterableQueue_ =

3083 template <typename K, typename V>
3084 MessageBuilder& operator<<(const QMap<K, V>& map_) {
3085 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL("[");
3086 QList<K> keys = map_.keys();
3087 typename QList<K>::const_iterator begin = keys.begin();
3088 typename QList<K>::const_iterator end = keys.end();
3089 int max_ = static_cast<int>(base::consts::kMaxLogPerContainer); // to prevent warning
3090 for (int index_ = 0; begin != end && index_ < max_; ++index_, ++begin) {
3091 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL("(");
3092 operator << (static_cast<K>(*begin));
3093 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL(", ");
3094 operator << (static_cast<V>(map_.value(*begin)));
3095 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL(")");
3096 m_logger->stream() << ((index_ < keys.size() -1) ? m_containerLogSeperator : ELPP_LITERAL(""));
3097 }
3098 if (begin != end) {
3099 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL("...");
3100 }
3101 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL("]");
3102 return *this;
3103 }

3114 typename QList<K>::const_iterator end = keys.end();

3116 for (int index_ = 0; begin != end && index_ < max_; ++index_, ++begin) {
3117 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL("(");
3118 operator << (static_cast<K>(*begin));
3119 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL(", ");
3120 operator << (static_cast<V>(hash_.value(*begin)));
3121 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL(")");
3122 m_logger->stream() << ((index_ < keys.size() -1) ? m_containerLogSeperator : ELPP_LITERAL(""));
3123 }
3124 if (begin != end) {
3125 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL("...");
3126 }
3127 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL("]");

3155#define MAKE_CONTAINERELPP_FRIENDLY(ContainerType, SizeMethod, ElementInstance) \
3156el::base::type::ostream_t& operator<<(el::base::type::ostream_t& ss, const ContainerType& container) {\
3157const el::base::type::char_t* sep = ELPP->hasFlag(el::LoggingFlag::NewLineForContainer) ? \
3158ELPP_LITERAL("\n ") : ELPP_LITERAL(", ");\
3159ContainerType::const_iterator elem = container.begin();\
3160ContainerType::const_iterator endElem = container.end();\
3161std::size_t size_ = container.SizeMethod; \
3162ss << ELPP_LITERAL("[");\
3163for (std::size_t i = 0; elem != endElem && i < el::base::consts::kMaxLogPerContainer; ++i, ++elem) { \
3164ss << ElementInstance;\
3165ss << ((i < size_ - 1) ? sep : ELPP_LITERAL(""));\
3166}\
3167if (elem != endElem) {\
3168ss << ELPP_LITERAL("...");\
3169}\
3170ss << ELPP_LITERAL("]");\
3171return ss;\
3172}
3173#if defined(ELPP_WXWIDGETS_LOGGING)
3174 ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_ONE_ARG(wxVector)
3175# define ELPP_WX_PTR_ENABLED(ContainerType) MAKE_CONTAINERELPP_FRIENDLY(ContainerType, size(), *(*elem))
3176# define ELPP_WX_ENABLED(ContainerType) MAKE_CONTAINERELPP_FRIENDLY(ContainerType, size(), (*elem))
3177# define ELPP_WX_HASH_MAP_ENABLED(ContainerType) MAKE_CONTAINERELPP_FRIENDLY(ContainerType, size(), \
3178ELPP_LITERAL("(") << elem->first << ELPP_LITERAL(", ") << elem->second << ELPP_LITERAL(")")
3179#else
3180# define ELPP_WX_PTR_ENABLED(ContainerType)
3181# define ELPP_WX_ENABLED(ContainerType)
3182# define ELPP_WX_HASH_MAP_ENABLED(ContainerType)
3183#endif // defined(ELPP_WXWIDGETS_LOGGING)
3184 // Other classes
3185 template <class Class>
3186 ELPP_SIMPLE_LOG(const Class&)
3187#undef ELPP_SIMPLE_LOG
3188#undef ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_ONE_ARG
3189#undef ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_TWO_ARG
3190#undef ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_THREE_ARG
3191#undef ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_FOUR_ARG
3192#undef ELPP_ITERATOR_CONTAINER_LOG_FIVE_ARG
3193 private:
3194 Logger* m_logger;
3195 const base::type::char_t* m_containerLogSeperator;
3196
3197 template<class Iterator>
3198 MessageBuilder& writeIterator(Iterator begin_, Iterator end_, std::size_t size_) {
3199 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL("[");
3200 for (std::size_t i = 0; begin_ != end_ && i < base::consts::kMaxLogPerContainer; ++i, ++begin_) {
3201 operator << (*begin_);
3202 m_logger->stream() << ((i < size_ - 1) ? m_containerLogSeperator : ELPP_LITERAL(""));
3203 }
3204 if (begin_ != end_) {
3205 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL("...");
3206 }
3207 m_logger->stream() << ELPP_LITERAL("]");
3208 if (ELPP->hasFlag(LoggingFlag::AutoSpacing)) {
3209 m_logger->stream() << " ";
3210 }
3211 return *this;
3212 }
3213};

3313// Logging from Logger class. Why this is here? Because we have Storage and Writer class available
3314#if ELPP_VARIADIC_TEMPLATES_SUPPORTED
3315template <typename T, typename... Args>
3316void Logger::log_(Level level, int vlevel, const char* s, const T& value, const Args&... args) {
3317 base::MessageBuilder b;
3318 b.initialize(this);
3319 while (*s) {
3320 if (*s == base::consts::kFormatSpecifierChar) {
3321 if (*(s + 1) == base::consts::kFormatSpecifierChar) {
3322 ++s;
3323 } else {
3324 if (*(s + 1) == base::consts::kFormatSpecifierCharValue) {
3325 ++s;
3326 b << value;
3327 log_(level, vlevel, ++s, args...);
3328 return;
3329 }
3330 }
3331 }
3332 b << *s++;
3333 }
3334 ELPP_INTERNAL_ERROR("Too many arguments provided. Unable to handle. Please provide more format specifiers", false);
3335}
3336template <typename T>
3337void Logger::log_(Level level, int vlevel, const T& log) {
3338 if (level == Level::Verbose) {
3339 if (ELPP->vRegistry()->allowed(vlevel, __FILE__)) {
3340 base::Writer(Level::Verbose, "FILE", 0, "FUNCTION",
3341 base::DispatchAction::NormalLog, vlevel).construct(this, false) << log;
3342 } else {
3343 stream().str(ELPP_LITERAL(""));
3344 releaseLock();
3345 }
3346 } else {
3347 base::Writer(level, "FILE", 0, "FUNCTION").construct(this, false) << log;
3348 }
3349}
3350template <typename T, typename... Args>
3351inline void Logger::log(Level level, const char* s, const T& value, const Args&... args) {
3352 acquireLock(); // released in Writer!
3353 log_(level, 0, s, value, args...);
3354}
3355template <typename T>
3356inline void Logger::log(Level level, const T& log) {
3357 acquireLock(); // released in Writer!
3358 log_(level, 0, log);
3359}
3360# if ELPP_VERBOSE_LOG
3361template <typename T, typename... Args>
3362inline void Logger::verbose(int vlevel, const char* s, const T& value, const Args&... args) {
3363 acquireLock(); // released in Writer!
3364 log_(el::Level::Verbose, vlevel, s, value, args...);
3365}
3366template <typename T>
3367inline void Logger::verbose(int vlevel, const T& log) {
3368 acquireLock(); // released in Writer!
3369 log_(el::Level::Verbose, vlevel, log);
3370}
3371# else
3372template <typename T, typename... Args>
3373inline void Logger::verbose(int, const char*, const T&, const Args&...) {
3374 return;
3375}
3376template <typename T>

3378 return;
3379}

3562class DefaultPerformanceTrackingCallback : public PerformanceTrackingCallback {
3563 protected:
3564 void handle(const PerformanceTrackingData* data) {
3565 m_data = data;
3566 base::type::stringstream_t ss;
3567 if (m_data->dataType() == PerformanceTrackingData::DataType::Complete) {
3568 ss << ELPP_LITERAL("Executed [") << m_data->blockName()->c_str() << ELPP_LITERAL("] in [") <<
3569 *m_data->formattedTimeTaken() << ELPP_LITERAL("]");
3570 } else {
3571 ss << ELPP_LITERAL("Performance checkpoint");
3572 if (!m_data->checkpointId().empty()) {
3573 ss << ELPP_LITERAL(" [") << m_data->checkpointId().c_str() << ELPP_LITERAL("]");
3574 }
3575 ss << ELPP_LITERAL(" for block [") << m_data->blockName()->c_str() << ELPP_LITERAL("] : [") <<
3576 *m_data->performanceTracker();
3577 if (!ELPP->hasFlag(LoggingFlag::DisablePerformanceTrackingCheckpointComparison)
3578 && m_data->performanceTracker()->m_hasChecked) {
3579 ss << ELPP_LITERAL(" ([") << *m_data->formattedTimeTaken() << ELPP_LITERAL("] from ");
3580 if (m_data->performanceTracker()->m_lastCheckpointId.empty()) {
3581 ss << ELPP_LITERAL("last checkpoint");
3582 } else {
3583 ss << ELPP_LITERAL("checkpoint '") << m_data->performanceTracker()->m_lastCheckpointId.c_str() << ELPP_LITERAL("'");
3584 }
3585 ss << ELPP_LITERAL(")]");
3586 } else {
3587 ss << ELPP_LITERAL("]");
3588 }
3589 }
3590 el::base::Writer(m_data->performanceTracker()->level(), m_data->file(), m_data->line(), m_data->func()).construct(1,
3591 m_data->loggerId().c_str()) << ss.str();
3592 }
3593 private:
3594 const PerformanceTrackingData* m_data;
3595};

3793 template <typename T>
3794 static std::string convertTemplateToStdString(const T& templ) {
3795 el::Logger* logger =
3796 ELPP->registeredLoggers()->get(el::base::consts::kDefaultLoggerId);
3797 if (logger == nullptr) {
3798 return std::string();
3799 }
3800 base::MessageBuilder b;
3801 b.initialize(logger);
3802 logger->acquireLock();
3803 b << templ;
3804#if defined(ELPP_UNICODE)
3805 std::string s = std::string(logger->stream().str().begin(), logger->stream().str().end());
3806#else
3807 std::string s = logger->stream().str();
3808#endif // defined(ELPP_UNICODE)
3809 logger->stream().str(ELPP_LITERAL(""));
3810 logger->releaseLock();
3811 return s;
3812 }
